title: [Main] - Bug 656559: Mileage: starting/ending point addresses over 50 characters fail to save on report lines (BC Text[50] limit not enforced)
summary: Fixes mileage starting and ending point addresses longer than 50 characters failing to save on expense report lines. Address field definitions change in the Expense, Expense Report Line and Posted Expense Report Line tables of the Expense Agent app.
key_points: Fixes bug 656559, where mileage start/end addresses over 50 characters failed to save
Touches address fields in the Expense table
Touches matching fields in Expense Report Line and Posted Expense Report Line
Small change of a few lines in each of the three tables
